items.title: Pay invoice for puppy course and private lesson
items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) = 21.11.2026. Per §187(1) BGB, since the period is measured from an event (the invoice date) rather than from the start of a day, the day of the event itself (21.11.) is excluded and counting starts on 22.11.2026. Counting 14 days: 22.11. is day 1 ... 05.12.2026 is day 14, so the 14-day period ends 05.12.2026. 05.12.2026 falls on a Saturday. Under §193 BGB, if the last day of a period for performing an act (including payment) falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it is replaced by the next working day. The next working day is Monday, 07.12.2026 (no NW public holiday in between).
